subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers adopt the open conflicting fork PR for this heartbeat prompt regression, or supersede it with a narrow same-repo repair?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the issue has an open linked fix candidate with closing syntax and a no-new-fix-pr label, so automation should not create another repair branch until maintainers choose the canonical path.

options.title: Supersede with same-repo repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor a focused same-repo fix with runner-level regression coverage for custom prompts and transcript separation.

options.title: Refresh the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase the existing fix candidate and add proof that custom prompts stay model-visible without the path hint.

options.title: Pause for owner triage
options.body: Keep this issue open without new repair automation until the heartbeat owner decides the exact prompt-boundary fix shape.

recommendation.title: Supersede with same-repo repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor a focused same-repo fix with runner-level regression coverage for custom prompts and transcript separation.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the path-hint behavior and authored the first same-repo repair attempt, making them the strongest routing signal for the prompt-hint boundary decision.
